clips.title: The story
paras: Gnolls have reached the western road into Redridge, and Lakeshire fears being cut off. Guard Parker spots camps near the border and sends word to Deputy Feldon. The warning confirms the town’s fear that the beastmen may isolate Redridge.

Guard Parker watches the western border trail, where the road runs from Elwynn Forest into Redridge Mountains. Stormwind’s forces have thinned, leaving the route with few defenders. Parker keeps the gravel road open for supply wagons, but his scouts find gnoll warbands advancing from the crags to the north and east. Their camps lie alarmingly close to the road.

Deputy Feldon receives the warning near the Lakeshire bridge and sees how much danger the town faces. Redridge gnolls are raiding near Lakeshire, and their camps near the Elwynn border could let them encircle the town and push into the kingdom’s heartland. Stormwind has ignored pleas for reinforcements, leaving Lakeshire’s watch unready for threats from both sides.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hail, shaman. I am charged to patrol this stretch of road. Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.
Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force! Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls. Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.
Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn?? They may be poised to advance into our homeland. Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only travelers under siege!
Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news. And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
